department: Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering

deadline.value: Non-Canadian applicants apply by April 1, 2027 for September entry (Canadians June 1).
deadline.quote: Application Deadlines Term Canadian Applicants Non-Canadian Applicants September Admission June 1 April 1

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: A professor must accept you into their research program before admission.
supervisor.quote: In order to be admitted to an academic graduate program, an applicant must be accepted by a professor into his/her research program, in addition to meeting all the above requirements for admission.

funding.value: Only limited scholarships and research/teaching assistantships may be available, depending on merit and funds.
funding.quote: Limited financial aid in the form of scholarships, research and teaching assistantships may be available, depending on (1) an applicant’s request in his/her application, (2) excellence of the applicant and (3) availability of funds.

entry_route.value: With a research master's the PhD needs 4 courses, otherwise 12; foreign students may be asked to start in the MASc as a qualifying period.
entry_route.quote: this degree program requires the candidates to complete 4 courses (12 credits), a seminar course and a research dissertation if a candidate already has a research Master's degree; otherwise the candidates have to complete 12 courses | Foreign students may be required to enter the M.A.Sc. program as a qualifying period prior to consideration for the Ph.D. program.

english_waiver.value: The department exempts English-taught degrees only from a country where English is the principal language, which may not cover India; otherwise request the FGS waiver or submit a test.
english_waiver.quote: Possession of a baccalaureate degree or its academic equivalent from an academic institution recognized by Dalhousie, in which the language of instruction is English, and in a country where English is the principal language

notes: Department page still quotes TOEFL on the old paper scale (580); the FGS iBT minimum applies.
